payload.title: Reconcile launch proof claims, social cards and draft indexing policy
payload.description: Follow-up proposal from the 2026-10-13 read-only review of Anth.us-Papyrus main 0fce81b and newly deployed production. Confirm annual versus monthly revenue; scope the claim that site commits are public while the new repo is private; attach public newsroom/process evidence; clarify ownership and experimental proof context; choose intentional draft indexing policy; replace generic and low-resolution commercial social cards; correct CTA contrast and remaining broken links. Evidence and source references are in audit task 63c510. No automatic source edits, repo visibility changes or releases are authorized by this review.
